description: Metro median house sales is a dataset listed in South Australian Government data directory (data.sa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department for Housing and Urban Development. Quarterly median house prices for metropolitan Adelaide by suburb. Coverage: South Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Department for Housing and Urban Development. Its tags are adelaide, house, price, sales, suburb. It offers 46 resource(s) in csv, xls, xlsx. The portal shows 2026-07-22 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-sa.
